items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: She had a German music teacher that teached me piano lessons and stuff

ctx.x: She did philharmonic rehearsals while I was still in the womb, you know, which she is going to do all that, you know. She had a German music teacher that teached me piano lessons and stuff and then launched my ass in space playing piano. And another thing a lot of people don’t realize, see when you come up in the black church, especially a prominent black church, to play on special events, even on Sundays to between 500 and a thousand people and get applause and smiles and coodles, that’s a big deal. This is a…
You had already played to some big crowds.
